0.why: src/SDLines.cpp:146 bounds the drawing loop by getChannels() capped at 16, and line 103 reads getVoltage(i) for each channel

comment: No family is written for the input: the module draws whatever is patched into it and gives the voltage no meaning of its own, which is the case STYLE reserves for leaving the colour off. Range and Mode are stored in the module's own JSON (src/SDLines.cpp:32) rather than as parameters, so neither can be clicked for help; they are written as Menu lines. The four ranges are the arrays at src/SDLines.cpp:21 and 22.
